entities.name: Meteor Hammer
entities.description: A spell Tetsuo Umezawa used to destroy the Imperial Shrine, making Jorgan Hage's warhammer fall from the edge of the atmosphere like a meteor.

entities.name: Tetsuo Umezawa
entities.description: The mage who used the Meteor Hammer spell to destroy the Imperial Shrine.

entities.name: Kolo Meha
entities.description: Teacher who taught Tetsuo the Meteor Hammer spell.

entities.name: Jorgan Hage
entities.description: Owner of the warhammer used in the Meteor Hammer spell.

entities.name: Imperial Shrine
entities.description: The shrine that gave Nicol Bolas the mana base he needed to manifest in Dominaria; destroyed by the Meteor Hammer.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Tyrannical ruler of the Madaran Empire who needed the Imperial Shrine's mana base to manifest in Dominaria.

entities.name: Madaran Empire
entities.description: Empire liberated from Nicol Bolas's tyrannical rule.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane where Nicol Bolas sought to manifest.

events.summary: Tetsuo Umezawa used the Meteor Hammer spell to destroy the Imperial Shrine, robbing Nicol Bolas of the mana base he needed to manifest in Dominaria.
events.quote: used by Tetsuo Umezawa to destroy the Imperial Shrine

events.summary: Kolo Meha taught Tetsuo the Meteor Hammer spell.
events.quote: Tetsuo was taught this spell by Kolo Meha

events.summary: The spell helped destroy Nicol Bolas and liberate the Madaran Empire.
events.quote: The spell was instrumental in the destruction of Nicol Bolas and the liberation of the Madaran Empire from his tyrannical rule.
